sources.description: Fictional support cases as of the bundled snapshot. customer_ref points to account_id; sku points to product_code. status is the current snapshot, not a historical event log.

documents.title: Lumen Bikes export timeout
documents.body: Nightly export times out for large reports. The case is open; the workaround is to reduce the export batch size.

documents.title: Lumen Bikes sign-in assistance
documents.body: The sign-in question was resolved by correcting the account's tenant selection.

documents.title: Cedar Books export question
documents.body: Cedar Books requested documentation for scheduling a daily export. The documentation request is open.

documents.title: Harbor Foods audit view
documents.body: The audit filter issue is resolved. The case is closed.

sources.description: Fictional product catalog and limits. product_code relates to sku in tickets. These notes describe capabilities, not customer-specific entitlements or service status.

documents.title: Northstar Export limits
documents.body: Northstar Export supports scheduled CSV exports. The documented maximum export batch size is 5000 records. For timeout investigations, reduce the batch size and include the job ID in the support case.

documents.title: Northstar Access overview
documents.body: Northstar Access supports single sign-on. It does not store customer passwords in support tickets.

documents.title: Northstar Audit retention
documents.body: Northstar Audit retains audit events for 30 days in this fictional product. This retention is unrelated to support-ticket retention.

sources.description: Fictional support policies. tier matches support_tier in accounts. Initial response targets are not guaranteed resolution times. There is no payment, payroll, or refund-approval dataset.

documents.title: Gold initial response
documents.body: Gold support has a one-business-hour initial response target. This is not a promise of issue resolution within one hour.

documents.title: Standard initial response
documents.body: Standard support has a one-business-day initial response target. This is not a resolution-time guarantee.

documents.title: Support ticket retention
documents.body: Support tickets are retained for 90 days in this fictional policy. This is distinct from Northstar Audit's event retention.

documents.title: Refund approval boundary
documents.body: Support agents may explain policies but cannot approve refunds. Refund status must be checked with the billing team; no refund ledger is available here.
